exposure: transanal repair of rectocele and rectal mucosectomy with a single circular stapler (TRREMS) procedure
outcome: postoperative complications (tenesmus, stenosis, residual mucosal prolapse, early bleeding, thrombosis)
straining and vaginal digitation during evacuatory effort
cohort: Consecutive patients with obstructed defecation symptoms (ODS) associated with rectocele who underwent the TRREMS procedure.
finding: The TRREMS procedure significantly improved evacuation disorders, with 97.5% of patients showing a significant reduction in the Cleveland Clinic constipation score.
mod_finding: No significant differences in the reduction of the CCS score were found according to the type of delivery.
